name: 6 V 5 A DC wall adapter
description: Regulated 6 V wall supply, up to 5 A, usually with a 5.5 x 2.1 mm barrel plug.
notes: Use the voltage and current printed on YOUR adapter label. 5 A must cover the peak (stall) current of everything on it.
Regulated switch-mode adapters hold the voltage within about +/-5 %; cheap unregulated ones can read well above the label with no load. Measure with a multimeter before connecting.
Use a barrel-jack-to-screw-terminal adapter; red wire to +, black to -. Check centre-positive.
Mains side is inside the sealed adapter; never open it or wire mains yourself.

pins.name: V+
pins.note: Centre-positive barrel plug on most adapters: check the polarity symbol on the label.

geometry.note: Size is the barrel-to-terminal adapter end; the brick itself stays off the build.
